blurb: England’s midfield control and set-piece edge should be enough to survive Haaland. It is a close call.

reasoning.title: Midfield geometry
reasoning.body: Rice and Bellingham close down the half-spaces where Norway start most of their attacks. Norway live on fast breaks, and the numbers say those chances dry up against this England midfield.

reasoning.title: The Haaland variable
reasoning.body: Haaland is the reason this call stays narrow. He turns half-chances into goals, and one touch can decide a knockout. Nobody at the desk thinks this is comfortable.

reasoning.title: Set pieces
reasoning.body: England attack dead balls better than anyone Norway have faced this cycle. In a game this tight, corners and free kicks are often the whole margin.

reasoning.title: Market drift
reasoning.body: The books moved toward England after midweek reports raised doubts about Ødegaard’s ankle. Our agents had priced that in a day earlier, which firms up the call.
